text: The authors find no empirical evidence that hedge fund adviser registration under the Dodd-Frank Act negatively affects hedge fund performance, contradicting the industry's claims.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389416

isBasedOn.name: Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance

abstract: Contrary to the claims of the hedge fund industry, we find no empirical evidence that would suggest that hedge fund adviser registration under the Dodd-Frank Act negatively affects hedge fund performance.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: US hedge fund advisers subject to Title IV
